---
title: "Data processing"
subtitle: "From source data to energy and air emissions accounts"
toc: false
---

The pages in this section describe step by step how the data provided by the authorities become accounts. Each page combines explanations with the Python code that carries them out. The pages are read in the order of their number, because each one uses tables produced by the previous ones.

The French pages run the code. This English version shows the same code without running it; results and tables are in the French pages and on the [downloads page](../telechargements.qmd). Code comments stay in French, as in the reference version.

| Page | Contents |
|:-----|:---------|
| [00. Reading the energy balance](00-bilan-energetique/index.qmd) | Reading the 2022 balance, long format and conversion to terajoules |
| [01. Extracting the energy balances](01-extraction-bilans/index.qmd) | ONEM balances from 2015 to 2022 in long format, stable flow and product codes, ktoe and TJ |
| [02. Extracting the GHG inventory](02-extraction-crt/index.qmd) | `Data` sheets of the CRT tables from 2015 to 2022, check against `Summary2` |
| [03. Extracting the supply and use tables](03-extraction-tre/index.qmd) | INS supply and use tables from 2015 to 2023 in long format, balance checks |
| [10. The balance in the PEFA Converter template](10-bilan-format-aie/index.qmd) | ONEM flows and products in the IEA layout, in TJ, with IEA signs |
| [11. From balance sectors to industries](11-activites/index.qmd) | Correspondence of balance flows with the 24 SUT industries and households, allocation keys for road transport and services |
| [12. Concordance matrix and bridging items](12-matrice-concordance/index.qmd) | Tunisian matrix by industry built on the default matrix of the tool, documented differences, bunkers and residence adjustments |
| [13. Physical energy supply and use tables](13-tableaux-pefa/index.qmd) | Explicit re-implementation of the PEFA Converter in polars, comparison with the tool, PEFA by industry from 2015 to 2022 |
| [14. Checks, indicators and export of the PEFA](14-controles-export-pefa/index.qmd) | Balance of the tables, plausibility against the SUT, energy intensities, workbooks in three languages |
